Manage external services required by ZQK.

This command allows you to start, stop, and check the status of services
like MemGraph that are used by the graph backend.

  Start MemGraph service
  zqk system service start memgraph
  Stop MemGraph service
  zqk system service stop memgraph
  Check service status
  zqk system service status memgraph
  List all available services
  zqk system service list

Usage:
  zqk system service [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List available services
  start       Start a service
  status      Check service status
  stop        Stop a service

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system service [command] --help" for more information about a command.
